```{r}

library(nlme)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{R}
clean_path <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/cleaned_dat/"

eoad <- read.csv(
  file.path(clean_path, "ptau_ref_long_only_eoad_90d.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    time_yrs_tau  = day_to_baseline_tau  / 365.25,
    time_yrs_ptau = day_to_baseline_ptau / 365.25,
    time_yrs_amy  = day_to_baseline_amy  / 365.25
  ) %>%  #filter longitudinal data
  group_by(subject_label) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
 

# Fit separate mixed models
tau_mod <- lme(
  fixed = desikan_suvr ~ time_yrs_tau,
  random = ~1|subject_label,
  data = eoad,
  na.action = na.omit,
  method = "REML"
)

ptau_mod <- lme(
  fixed = log(ptau217) ~ time_yrs_ptau, # toggle log or not log
  random = ~1|subject_label,
  data = eoad,
  na.action = na.omit,
  method = "REML"
)

amy_mod <- lme(
  fixed = centiloid_wcbl ~ time_yrs_amy,
  random = ~1|subject_label,
  data = eoad,
  na.action = na.omit,
  method = "REML"
)

# Helper: fixed-effect trajectory + 95% CI
make_pred <- function(mod, time_var, time_name, y_name, n = 200) {
  dat <- mod$data
  x <- dat[[time_var]]
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  grid <- data.frame(
    x = seq(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n)
  )
  names(grid) <- time_name

  X <- model.matrix(
    as.formula(paste("~", time_name)),
    data = grid
  )

  beta <- fixef(mod)
  V <- vcov(mod)

  fit <- as.numeric(X %*% beta)
  se  <- sqrt(diag(X %*% V %*% t(X)))

  grid %>%
    mutate(
      fit = fit,
      lwr = fit - 1.96 * se,
      upr = fit + 1.96 * se,
      biomarker = y_name
    )
}

# Prediction data
pred_ptau <- make_pred(ptau_mod, "time_yrs_ptau", "time_yrs_ptau", "p-tau217")
pred_amy  <- make_pred(amy_mod,  "time_yrs_amy",  "time_yrs_amy",  "Centiloid")
pred_tau  <- make_pred(tau_mod,  "time_yrs_tau",  "time_yrs_tau",  "Tau PET")


pred_ptau <- pred_ptau %>%
  rename(time = time_yrs_ptau) %>%
  mutate(biomarker = "p-tau217")

pred_amy <- pred_amy %>%
  rename(time = time_yrs_amy) %>%
  mutate(biomarker = "Centiloid")

pred_tau <- pred_tau %>%
  rename(time = time_yrs_tau) %>%
  mutate(biomarker = "Tau PET")

pred_all <- bind_rows(pred_ptau, pred_amy, pred_tau) %>%
  mutate(
    biomarker = factor(biomarker, levels = c("p-tau217", "Centiloid", "Tau PET"))
  )

# Spaghetti data with modality-specific time variables
spaghetti <- eoad %>%
  select(
    subject_label,
    ptau217,time_yrs_ptau,
    centiloid_wcbl, time_yrs_amy,
    desikan_suvr, time_yrs_tau
  ) %>%
  mutate(log_ptau217 = log(ptau217)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(log_ptau217, centiloid_wcbl, desikan_suvr),
    names_to = "marker",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time = case_when(
      marker == "log_ptau217" ~ time_yrs_ptau, #toggle ptau217
      marker == "centiloid_wcbl" ~ time_yrs_amy,
      marker == "desikan_suvr" ~ time_yrs_tau
    ),
    biomarker = case_when(
      marker == "log_ptau217" ~ "p-tau217", # toggle ptau217
      marker == "centiloid_wcbl" ~ "Centiloid",
      marker == "desikan_suvr" ~ "Tau PET"
    ),
    biomarker = factor(biomarker, levels = c("p-tau217", "Centiloid", "Tau PET"))
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(time), is.finite(value))



```


```{r}
# Colors for individual trajectories
traj_cols <- c(
  "p-tau217" = "lightblue",
  "Centiloid" = "lightgreen",
  "Tau PET" = "coral"
)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = spaghetti,
    aes(x = time, y = value, group = subject_label, color = biomarker),
    alpha = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_all,
    aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
    fill = "grey60",
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_all,
    aes(x = time, y = fit),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = traj_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~ biomarker, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "years from baseline",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8))
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "eoad_spaghetti_lme_trajectories.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 100
)

p <- p +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ biomarker,
    nrow = 1,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(
      biomarker = c(
        "p-tau217" = "log(p-tau217)",
        "Centiloid" = "Centiloid",
        "Tau PET" = "Tau PET"
      )
    )
  )
p
```


```{r}
  
ptaum <- lmer(
   log(ptau217) ~ time_yrs_ptau + (1|subject_label),
  data = eoad,
  na.action = na.omit,
  REML = FALSE
)
summary(ptaum)
standardise_parameters(ptaum)
pr2 <- partR2(
  ptaum,
  R2_type = "marginal",
  data = eoad,
  nboot = NULL,  # start without bootstrap,
  partvars = c(  "time_yrs_ptau")
)

pr2$R2 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```
